badges.why: One row per badge awarded to a user, stamped with Date; UserId repeats.

comments.why: One row per comment on a post, stamped with CreationDate; PostId and UserId repeat.

postHistory.why: One row per revision of a post, stamped with CreationDate, pointing at posts and users.

postLinks.why: One row per link made between two posts, stamped with CreationDate; points at posts twice.

posts.why: One row per question or answer keyed by Id; comments, votes, postHistory, postLinks and tags point at it, and CreationDate is its business date.

tags.why: One row per tag keyed by Id with its usage count and excerpt post; nothing points at it.

users.why: One row per site user keyed by Id with reputation and vote counts; most tables point at it, and CreationDate is the signup date.

votes.why: One row per vote on a post, stamped with CreationDate; PostId repeats.
